🚀 We are thrilled to introduce Omnipost Social Engine v1.0 — the open-source social orchestration framework for Python.

Managing multi-platform developer advocacy and marketing shouldn't require five different dashboard tabs and fragile cron jobs.

Omnipost provides:
✅ Real-time multi-platform simulator (Twitter, LinkedIn, BlueSky, Threads, Mastodon)
✅ Automated thread splitting & unicode mathematical typography
✅ Algorithmic virality scoring before publication
✅ Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Cline
